bucket_C_not_planned_regular_contributor.title: macOS: use a command launch helper to shed responsible process bit for power, memory, etc. tracking
bucket_C_not_planned_regular_contributor.body_preview:
When Ghostty launches the shell, macOS views it as the "responsible process." All permissions (TCC like Documents/Downloads/etc.), metrics (power reporting), etc. go through Ghostty and are represented by Ghostty.

This has led to confusion on multiple fronts:

* People ask why Ghostty is using so much power, when its a running program in the shell.
* The above also hides issues when we're actually the source of power usage (a bug!)
* People have gotten scared when "Ghostty" asks for permission
